line: Bed drawer: the Stay tile now shows the day of the stay, for example "Day 37".
The Demo chip now shows the ward clock time, such as Demo 14:20, instead of a seconds counter.
The ED wait labels on Movements rows now say Long wait and Over target instead of Due soon and Overdue.
Marking a seclusion room available or out of service now asks you to confirm first.
Plan next return now opens the patient longest past discharge with no plan.
Acknowledge visible now asks you to confirm, then lets you undo for a few seconds.
Bed map squares on Capacity now open that ward's bed board.
Update a bed now lets you choose a ward, then opens that ward's page.
The referral form's side panel now shows what's left to fill in before you can send.
Capacity now counts locked beds within the total and labels each figure the same way on every screen.
The Activity feed now shows recent actions from every computer at your desk, not just this one.
Closing a ward keeps your reason and time if the save is refused, and reopening a ward now asks you to confirm.
The plus and minus buttons in Settings are now larger and easier to tap.
Patient search movement rows now show surname first.
You can now dismiss the note about an uncertain save once you have read it.
Add patient now shows only on desks that are allowed to add a patient.
If two people close the same ward, the second now sees who closed it first and can try again.
A coordinator can now record that a person has left, from the Discharges sheet.
Help adds spelling fixes, grouped words, accessibility, first-visit hints and printable desk guides.
Settings: Restore now names all twelve rules, and Export saves only the saved rules.
